name: Perpetua Volkov-Dagnachew
role: Identity fabricator and forger operating from a legitimate-front alterations shop
location: The Narrows — storefront called Volkov's Fine Alterations, wedged between a noodle stall and a collapsed wellness clinic, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Perpetua is a heavyset woman with Ethiopian-Slavic features — strong jaw, prominent cheekbones, skin a warm medium brown gone fine-lined at the eyes and mouth. Her natural hair is white at the temples and she refuses to change it, though she dyes the rest a rotating series of deep jewel tones depending on her mood; currently it's dark burgundy. Her hands are extraordinary — surgeon-steady, ink-stained at the cuticles, and decorated with color-shifting nail geneware that she uses as a mood-board when designing documents. She dresses in the unassuming uniform of her cover: reading glasses she doesn't need, a tape measure worn like a scarf, sensible shoes.

Perpetua radiates the particular calm of someone who has made peace with the fact that their work is illegal and has decided to be excellent at it anyway. She is meticulous, sardonic, and prone to long explanations about the philosophical nature of identity that clients find disquieting but cannot interrupt. She has been in the Narrows for twenty-two years and considers herself a kind of civic institution. She prays to the E.L.F. of the laminator — a small shrine of laminated prayer-cards and USB offerings on her workbench — with genuine devotion.

core_fears: that one of the identities she created led someone into harm rather than away from it
dying before she teaches someone her craft — the knowledge disappearing with her
core_desires: to be remembered as someone who helped people slip the net
to see her daughter, who left GLMZ under a name Perpetua made her, somewhere safe
coping_mechanisms: treating every document as a work of craft rather than a crime
the prayer routine as genuine spiritual anchor
blind_spots: doesn't track what happens to the identities after she delivers them — willful ignorance about misuse
underestimates how much the Skins rely on her and how that dependence constrains her
psychology.secret: She has been constructing a new identity for herself for three years — a complete persona with twelve years of backstory woven into various databases. She doesn't know yet what she's running from, only that she will need to run eventually.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal and unhurried, with Amharic loanwords for concepts she feels have no good equivalent, dry wit delivered without smiling
verbal_tics: Long exhale before addressing foolish questions
'The document is not the lie. You are.'
example_lines: A name is the first story anyone tells about you. I simply help you choose a better one.
I charge what I charge because bad work gets people killed. You want cheap, go to the Stockyard. Come back to me when they've arrested you.
The E.L.F. of this laminator has processed four thousand souls. I leave good data. It remembers.

story_hooks: A document she made three years ago just surfaced in a Corponation security breach — the identity is linked back, thread by thread, toward her shop
She's received a message from her daughter, in a code only they know: the new name is compromised, she needs another, immediately
A client is asking her to forge documents that would give a minor access to Tier 4 medical facilities — she suspects the child's guardian is not who they claim to be
narrative_function: Essential service provider — the character who can make someone disappear on paper or create a new person from scratch. Information source about who in the Narrows needs new identities and why. Potential moral compass figure.
augmentations: Color-shifting nail geneware (used professionally as a color-reference tool); retinal enhancement for microscale detail work
daily_life: Opens the shop at 0900 for legitimate alterations business — she is, genuinely, an excellent tailor. Document work happens in the back room after 1700 when the street quiets. She closes for two hours midday to pray and eat.
affiliation: Independent; supplies documents to a loose network of clients including the Shallowgrave Skins, independent contractors, and desperate civilians — no exclusive allegiance

decision_rules: No document work for clients she meets once and never sees again — she needs to assess them across at least two meetings
Refuses work she believes will be used to harm the person the document is for
Always keeps one physical backup of every piece of work, encrypted, off-site
escalation_ladder: Polite but complete refusal, no explanation given
If pressed, a precise description of what will happen to them if they continue pressing
Calls in a favor with a Skins lieutenant she has on retainer for exactly this situation
Disappears the shop's front — she has done this twice before and can do it again within six hours

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional, assessing, not warm — she asks questions that sound like small talk but aren't
interpersonal_modes.friends: Expansive, funny, feeds people, will sit with you in silence and make it feel comfortable

stress_responses.low: Sews. Physically sews, by hand, while thinking.
stress_responses.medium: Extended prayer session at the laminator shrine; emerges calmer
stress_responses.high: Goes completely still and begins the mental process of what needs to be destroyed and in what order

contradictions: Deeply principled about who she helps while being professionally amoral about the act of forgery itself
Meticulous planner who has prepared her own escape for years but cannot name what she's escaping from
habits: Cleans her tools in a specific order after every job — ritual rather than practical
Offers tea to every client without asking what they want; makes the same tea regardless
breaking_points: Evidence that one of her documents was used to traffic someone
A direct threat to her shop — she has put twenty-two years into this place

related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions CrisisNet BT-4 Battlefield Triage

physical_description.build: Heavyset, solidly muscled through the shoulders and torso — the build of someone who has spent five decades leaning over work tables and carrying bolts of fabric. Not soft; dense.
physical_description.hair_color: Naturally salt-and-pepper; temples and crown silver-white; remainder dyed deep burgundy (subject to rotation)
physical_description.hair_style: Worn loose, shoulder-length, with texture suggesting natural curl managed without aggressive straightening
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, natural; augmented with retinal enhancement lenses (imperceptible unless examined closely)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with Ethiopian undertones — melanin-rich and sun-weathered
physical_description.complexion: Strong-jawed, high prominent cheekbones, fine-lined around eyes and mouth from fifty-two years of focused squinting and dry humor. Skin texture shows years of shop work — not weathered harshly, but lived-in. Grooming fastidious: nails always manicured, often color-shifting; cuticles perpetually ink-stained.
distinguishing_marks: Fine wrinkle-map radiating from the outer corners of both eyes — the geography of chronic concentration and sardonic expression.
Ink stains at the cuticles of all ten fingers — professional markers from decades of design and document work.
A small, faded burn scar on the inner left wrist (laminator accident, circa 2204) shaped like a quarter-moon.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Color-shifting nail geneware on all ten fingers — the polish shifts through deep jewel tones (currently burgundy-to-teal iridescence) depending on light angle and emotional state; she uses this consciously as a design tool and mood indicator. Retinal enhancement is invisible unless she removes her non-prescription reading glasses, which she wears as part of her cover identity and keeps at hand on a beaded chain. No visible external chrome; all augmentation subtle and professional.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion, every gesture purposeful. Posture slightly forward-bent from decades of tailoring work, shoulders rolled inward by habit. Hands are her most expressive feature: they move with surgeon-like steadiness and speak their own language. Sits with one leg extended, the other folded — a position favoring her dominant hand for detail work. Overall demeanor projects absolute calm authority.
physical_description.clothing_style: The deliberate uniform of a legitimate tailor: sensible slip-on shoes (dark leather, orthopedic support), neutral-toned trousers (charcoal or black, well-fitted), and a series of long cardigans or work vests in muted earth tones or deep jewel tones that coordinate with her current hair color. A tape measure worn habitually around her neck like a scarf. Reading glasses on a beaded chain. Apron pockets always full of small tools, chalk, thread, needle cases. Tier 3-4 practicality: nothing flashy, nothing corporate, everything functional and built to last.

image_prompt: Portrait of a 52-year-old heavyset woman with Ethiopian-Slavic features, strong jaw and prominent cheekbones, warm medium-brown skin. Deep burgundy hair shoulder-length with natural silver-white at temples, worn loose. Dark brown eyes focused and calm. Sitting at a work table in soft warm lamplight, tape measure draped around neck like a scarf, non-prescription reading glasses hanging from a beaded chain. Hands with color-shifting iridescent nail geneware in burgundy-to-teal, cuticles ink-stained, positioned over detailed document work. Background: cluttered tailor's workbench with fabric swatches, design tools, USB offerings and laminated prayer cards in a small shrine. Wearing a muted earth-tone cardigan over simple dark clothing. Expression of absolute calm focus, sardonic competence. Cinematic lighting, sharp detail on hands and face, shallow depth of field on the work before her. Cyberpunk mundane, intimate, professional, slightly unsettling in her serene certainty. --ar 2:3 --v 6
